member.name: T:Tuinet.Graphemes

Grapheme clusters: what a reader sees as one character, possibly several code points (e + combining accent, 👨‍👩‍👧, ❤️, 🇵🇱, Hangul jamo). Boundaries follow UAX #29 via , with fast paths so plain Latin and CJK text never calls it.

member.name: T:Tuinet.Renderer
